release_notes:
• Low-End Device Optimizations: Disabled heavy OLED canvas grain, decoupled mini-player marquee ticker, downsampled palette quantization, and reduced memory usage for lag-free performance on all phones
• Song Slider Seek Fix: Fixed 20-30s playback freeze when seeking; range streaming requests are guarded to prevent stream cancellation storms
• Volume Disparity Fix: Initial normal playback volume now starts at full volume without needing to toggle 8D on and off
• Clean Minimal UI Redesign: Removed shuffle and 8D buttons from home hero rotating cards, removed Direct Audio Stream strip, improved Search page, and removed button glow in Settings
